"Entwicklung der Großhandels-Strompreise in Deutschland und Europa und des EUA-Preises bis ca. 2040. Wirtschaftlichkeit einzelner Technologien, Marktwert der erneuerbaren Energien.". Coverage: Germany. Time resolution: hour. Spatial resolution: continents, national states, regions. Software: GAMS. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
